system.description: You plant a staff or sword in the ground and swear an oath.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the sentry also points toward the threat.
outcomes.success: A spectral, unmoving sentry stands guard for 8 hours. It does not fight, but it sounds a deafening celestial trumpet blast if any hostile creature comes within 100'.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time is lost.
outcomes.ruin: The sentry appears, but it sounds its trumpet at midnight for no reason, waking everything within a mile. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
